How to Play
Complete game guide
DEBRIS SURGE
Arcade espacial de supervivencia

Eres el piloto de un satélite orbital encargado de limpiar la basura espacial que amenaza las órbitas terrestres. Absorbe escombros, esquiva peligros y escala niveles para batir tu récord.

Absorbe
6 tipos de debris con distintos valores
Esquiva
Meteoros y tóxicos que quitan vidas
Combina
Combos x25 y power-ups para el máximo score
∞ Niveles 7 Skins 6 Power-ups Misiones diarias Combo x25
OBJETIVO DEL JUEGO
Mueve tu satélite para absorber debris espacial y acumular puntos. Absorbe rápido y en cadena para activar el multiplicador de combo hasta x25. ¡Cada nivel sube la dificultad!
CONTROLES
📱 Móvil
Arrastra el dedo por la pantalla

⌨️ PC: WASD / ↑↓←→ mover · P pausar

PELIGROS — ¡ESQUIVA ESTOS!
✗ El contacto quita -1 vida
Meteoro ☄
-1 ❤️ vida
Roca espacial con estela de fuego. Se mueve en diagonal a alta velocidad. Llega en oleadas cada 5 niveles.
Tóxico ☠
-1 ❤️ vida
Nube de gas tóxico que flota lentamente. Tiene un aura punteada que indica su zona de daño. ¡No te dejes rodear!
💡
Si ves un meteoro o tóxico acercarse, mueve el satélite en dirección opuesta. El escudo (power-up verde) absorbe un impacto. Las oleadas tóxicas aparecen cada 7 niveles — esquiva moviéndote constantemente.

CONSEJOS PRO
Combo x25: mueve el satélite en círculos amplios para pasar cerca de varios debris seguidos. No esperes — actúa rápido antes de que el temporizador expire.
Oleadas cada 5 niveles: Oleadas de meteoros cada 5 niveles y oleadas tóxicas cada 7. En ambas mantente en los bordes y zigzaguea — los tóxicos son más lentos pero más grandes.
Ancestral y Legendario: brillan con un halo especial. Son raros y dan 25–40 pts — abandona el debris normal cercano y ve por ellos.
Power-ups: guarda el Escudo para las oleadas. Sobrecarga: pulso EMP + encadena debris cercanos mientras está activa.
Jefes en nivel 10: absorbe primero sus escudos orbitales para exponer el núcleo, luego absorbe el núcleo para derrotarlo. ¡Ganas puntos extra y una vida!

    Privacy Policy
    DEBRIS SURGE · June 2026

    Debris Surge is designed with privacy by default. We collect only what is strictly necessary to run the game. No personal data. No tracking. No ads. Your progress lives on your device.

    1 · Data We Collect

    Your game progress — scores, skins, achievements, settings, and streak — is stored locally on your device using the browser's localStorage. This data never leaves your device automatically.

    When you participate in global rankings, your anonymous player ID, username, and score are sent to our leaderboard server (hosted on Railway). We never receive your real name, email, or any identifiable information.

    2 · Payments

    Premium skins are purchased through PayPal. Debris Surge never sees or stores your payment details. All transactions are processed securely by PayPal under their own privacy policy.

    Once a purchase is confirmed, your skin is linked to your anonymous player ID on our server so it can be restored if you clear your browser data. No personal identifiers are stored alongside it.

    3 · No Personal Data

    We do not collect your real name, email address, phone number, IP address, or any other personally identifiable information. Your player ID is a randomly generated string created locally on your device — it carries no identity data.

    4 · localStorage, Not Cookies

    Debris Surge uses browser localStorage — not cookies — to save your settings, progress, and preferences. This means no data is sent with HTTP requests and no tracking can occur through this mechanism. You can clear it at any time through your browser's site data settings.

    5 · Third-Party Services

    PayPal — used for optional skin purchases. Subject to PayPal's own privacy policy at paypal.com/privacy.

    Railway — our leaderboard backend. Stores only your anonymous player ID and score. No analytics, no profiling, no ads.

    6 · Your Rights & Data Deletion

    You can delete all local data at any time using the Danger Zone option in the menu. This permanently removes your progress, records, skins, and achievements from your device.

    For questions about leaderboard data or any other privacy concerns, contact us through the game's social channels.

    Debris Surge collects no advertising data, sells no data, and uses no third-party analytics.
    This policy may be updated as the game evolves. Last revised: June 2026.

    📋 Terms of Service
    Last updated: March 2026

    1. Acceptance
    By playing Debris Surge, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the game.

    2. Game access
    Debris Surge is a free browser game. You may play it for personal, non-commercial use. You may not copy, modify, or redistribute the game without permission.

    3. Purchases
    Premium skin purchases are final and non-refundable, except where required by law. Purchased skins are tied to your anonymous player ID. We are not responsible for progress lost due to browser data clearing, though we provide a restore feature backed by our server.

    4. Fair play
    Score manipulation, hacking, or exploiting bugs to gain unfair advantages may result in removal from the global leaderboard.

    5. Availability
    We may update, modify, or discontinue the game at any time without notice.

    6. Limitation of liability
    The game is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any damages arising from use of the game.
